name: footer-bento
title: Footer Bento
description: A multi-tile footer laid out as a bento grid. A large card carries the call to action, while smaller tiles hold social links, an email signup, the office location and privacy links.
use: A marketing site footer should carry a final CTA plus social, signup and legal information in one band.
avoid: The page needs a minimal one-line footer; five cards take a lot of vertical space.
a11y: Native controls are focusable, but the email field relies on its placeholder and has no persistent label. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark page footer built from five rounded cards. A tall left card holds an icon, a bold headline, a paragraph and two buttons; four smaller tiles across the right hold social pills, a light email signup, an address and legal links.
behaves: Static layout. Buttons, pills and the email field respond to hover and focus, and the newsletter field accepts typed text; nothing animates.
customise: All copy, links and the newsletter field are written in the source; colours follow the neutral palette and adapt to dark mode.
weight: light: Static cards and links with no scripts or animation.
demo: 'Start your journey today.', socials Twitter/GitHub/LinkedIn/Discord, 'San Francisco, CA', Privacy and Terms.
issues: The newsletter input has only a placeholder, no persistent label.
Social pills and legal links point to '#', so they go nowhere in the demo.
polishWhy: Tidy card grid and clear hierarchy; placeholder-only field and dead links are the weak spots.
